Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is our SIG questionnaire (Alpha_SIG_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx). For procurement and our security review team we need a control-level traceability: for each SIG control please indicate Redwood's mapping to SOC 2 or ISO 27001 controls (if applicable), the internal owner, and the specific evidence artifacts you can provide (logs, screenshots, configs, policy excerpts) along with a sample filename and approximate dates.

Our goal is to complete the intake and validate high-risk controls in two weeks. Can you confirm the following by EOD Monday?
- Do you have a standard traceability template you prefer we use?
- Who will be the point-of-contact on the Redwood side (name, title)?
- Will you be able to deliver a bulk evidence bundle (encrypted archive) or staged links?

We typically handle evidence via an SSO-protected Box folder (we'll share a link). Attached is the questionnaire for your mapping. Hoping to schedule a 30-minute intake call to align scope and timelines — are you available tomorrow afternoon CET?

Thanks,
Megan

Hi Megan / Procurement team —

Great call earlier — thanks for the alignment. Summary and immediate deliverables below (so we have a single source of truth):

Scope agreed: SIG controls relevant to cloud-hosted LLM inference (authentication/authorization, key management, telemetry/observability, deployment isolation, data handling, incident response).

Deliverables and timeline:
- 2026-11-06: Upload SIG-Traceability-Template.csv (populated with initial mappings for SOC 2 controls and ISO 27001 clauses) — DONE (uploaded to Box).
- 2026-11-09: Control evidence index (control-matrix-v1.csv) with columns: SIG_Control_ID, Redwood_Control_ID, Control_Owner, Evidence_Type, Evidence_Filename, Evidence_Date, Notes.
- 2026-11-12: Staged evidence bundle (encrypted ZIP) for high/medium risk controls; low-risk controls via shared links.

Notes on approach:
- Mapping rules: We map SIG controls to our SOC 2 control IDs (e.g., CC7.1 = Access Reviews) and to the closest ISO 27001 clause where applicable. Where no 1:1 exists we add a "coverage note" (column in the matrix) explaining how multiple internal processes satisfy the requirement.
- Evidence conventions: filenames will follow: <Redwood_Control_ID>_<evidence-type>_<date>. Example: ACC-03_access-review_20261031.pdf. We will include a small sample of raw logs (sample-logs-20261031.txt) with hashes for verification; full logging extracts will be provided under NDA if required.
- Sensitive artifacts: for key material or HSM proofs we will provide architecture diagrams and KMS audit records (redacted) rather than raw keys.

Attachments uploaded to Box folder (links in Box): control-matrix-v1.csv, sample-logs-20261031.txt. I'll also add a readme with mapping conventions and a short video walkthrough (internal).

If procurement needs a packaged statement of responsibility or a short summary for purchase order review I can provide that by EOD Friday. Otherwise we'll proceed with the 11/12 staged bundle date.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Security Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: sample-logs-20261031.txt (text/plain, 120 KB)
